يبتدعوا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَدِعُوا (yabtadiʕū) /jab.ta.di.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# يُبْتَدَعُوا (yubtadaʕū) /jub.ta.da.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
